ns2:section.sectionText: The course is designed for students considering academic careers. Topics will include designing a research agenda; publishing strategies; networking; pursuing a position in higher education; creating a professional and public profile; achieving tenure; teaching and professional service. Students will work collaboratively on projects designed to assist their efforts to pursue a scholarly career, including preparing a research statement and presentation, identifying career opportunities, and interviewing. This class will meet in room 333 of the Education Building.
